note: The hub as the designer locked it, inside out. Every value carries its status word and source: DECIDED (the designer), REGISTER (carried from presets/electromagnets-RA.json), DESIGN / PROPOSED (sized or proposed here, the designer's to accept), ESTIMATE, OPEN (a placeholder [RH] until the designer sets it). Read by sim/hub_locked.py and sim/hub_rings_build.py.

value: AH cores with their coils (on the z axis, top and bottom)
retainer (holds the vessel, the rings and the AH)
shaft (the same shaft top and bottom, one half per side)
pumps (each shaft half carries its side's electrostatic and magnetic pump, symmetric)

vessel_wall.source: designer, 2026-10-09 (shell stress about 0.8 MPa under vacuum)

vessel_resistivity.status: OPEN (the bench's phase 3 measures it) / ESTIMATE (in service)
vessel_resistivity.source: borosilicate at 25 C, datasheet-class (about 1e15 ohm cm); falls steeply with temperature; in service: the glass between the rings at 32.5 C in a 25 C room (the AH coils' 1.2 W each), Arrhenius through sim/hub_drift.py's 25 / 40 C points (sim/hub_thermal.py, sim/hub-thermal-findings.md)

value.role: the field's electrodes: the rings outside the glass (not electrodes inside the vacuum)
value.where: on the vessel's outer surface, one on each hemisphere, mirror-symmetric about the equator
value.form: prototype: bands of 0.1 mm annealed copper foil on the glass (cut as gores to fit the sphere, overlapped 1 mm, bedded in the gel), each edge beaded with a copper wire ring; a fired-on coating later (its edges beaded or graded the same way)

joints.laps: every cut edge deburred; each lap's free edge under a solder fillet >= 0.2 mm wide (or dressed round, r >= 25 um); the lap burnished into the gel film, its ramp within 0.5 mm; no void under a lap, the more so within 3 mm of the equatorial beads
joints.closing_joints: the equatorial rings butt-joined and dressed to the wire's round within 0.03 mm over 1 mm (delta / w <= 0.03); the polar rings seamless (turned, or brazed and turned to the round), or the AH ends rounded to 1.5 mm and the joint within 0.006 mm over 1 mm; no solder ball on any bead
joints.contacts: the gel void-free in each contact's wedge, the equatorial ones above all: a sealed void reaching 0.5 mm from an equatorial contact breaks down once the DC has settled (0.99 of Paschen in service)

value.supply: DC, the symmetric supply: ring A on its own 2-stage Cockcroft-Walton chain from the shaft on node 1 (-15.0 kV), ring B on the mirror chain on node 4 (+15.0 kV); 29.9 kV across, the null at the shaft's potential; storage 100 pF; no Dk, no C_A

rings.status: DECIDED (rings outside the glass; copper foil with rounded edges for the prototype; the symmetric supply) / DESIGN (edges, beads: sim/hub_rings_build.py)
rings.source: designer, 2026-10-09 (the rings; then the symmetric supply, 'if it pumps against the core centre, yes'); the design from sim/hub-rings-build-findings.md: the most field at the null with the gap holding the interface rating along the glass and both beads the gel's rating (ratings below), in the mirror family. Supersedes the asymmetric 25.75-57.7 deg on ring B's 2 stages and Dk (6.93 kV/cm), and the lock-down's 20-53 deg on three stages, whose edges were not checked. Drawing: docs/drawings/DCCREG-HUB-201; design: docs/rings-design.md. The field at the null as built: 7.62 kV/cm at switch-on with the beads in their grooves (7.10 the bands alone, on which the edges were sized), settling to 8.20 kV/cm at 25 C as the insulators leak (sim/hub_beads_settled.py, sim/hub_rings_build.py's as-built step, sim/hub_drift.py).
rings.tag: [RH] the ratings; [IR] the field solves (a modelling choice); [OC] the electrostatics they solve

ratings.status: DESIGN (the record's) / OPEN until the bench qualifies them
ratings.source: interface: the average DC along the glass between the rings, under the gel and the retainer; gel: the peak DC field at a bead in void-free silicone gel, about a third of its short-term strength. The bench test qualifies both (docs/bench-test-rings.md phase 1); they set the stages (sim/hub-rings-build-findings.md).

value.dominated_by: the multiplier's diodes and capacitors and the HV assembly's surface; the rings' own insulation leaks about a thousand times less

rings_leakage.source: sim/hub_rings_build.py LEAKAGE (datasheet-class parts); replaces the 10 G placeholder

value.where: on the z axis, top and bottom of the vessel

material_data.source: Fair-Rite's 77 material data sheet (https://www.fair-rite.com/77-material-data-sheet/), as a web search rendered it on 2026-10-09; not re-read here (the session's network policy blocks the host): verify against the current sheet before ordering
material_data.note: the register's rho 5 ohm m (presets/electromagnets-RA.json AH_rod) is five times the sheet's; at 120 Hz either leaves a skin depth of metres. B_sat at 100 C is the register's 0.38 T, not on the rendered sheet

coil.window: variant (a)'s window, 3.2 x 40 mm (its 50 turns of 1.6 mm wire), rewound with 160 turns
coil.wire: 0.80 mm grade-1 enamelled (0.869 mm over), orthocyclic, 4 layers of up to 46 turns, 3.13 mm build

value.potential: the coil's cold end; the core tied to it (about the shaft's potential)
value.end: the outer corner facing the seat rounded to r >= 1.5 mm at REF: a conductive-coated former flange tied to the core, or a REF end ring over the last turns

AH.status: DECIDED (placement) / REGISTER (dimensions) / DESIGN (the winding) / PROPOSED (the end's radius)
AH.source: designer, 2026-10-08; presets/electromagnets-RA.json AH_rod, AH_former, AH_variants (a); sim/magnetic_doubler.py AH r160; the winding: sim/hub_thermal.py (the deck keeps 0.27 ohm, the bare-copper scaling); the end: sim/hub-beads-settled-findings.md §5; the core's material data: Fair-Rite's 77 data sheet (core.material_data)

value.between: the vessel's pole and the core's tip
value.holds: 4.5 kV/mm in the PEEK settled at the AH end rounded to 1.5 mm; 2.3 kV/mm on average (sim/hub-beads-settled-findings.md §5)

AH_seat.source: presets/electromagnets-RA.json (sim/em_solids.py RA_seat); now 5.7 mm with the 50 mm vessel

value.holds: the vessel, the rings, the AH cores and coils
value.material: PEEK, unfilled (natural grade; no carbon or glass fill), machined from annealed stock
value.pocket: 0.5 mm over the glass with grooves for the rings' beads, filled with the interface filler
value.alternative: PEI (Ultem 1000), eps 3.15: higher resistivity and strength, slower to settle, more moisture
value.grooves: full-round tops, a ball-end cut concentric with each bead with 1.0 mm of gel over it: 5 x 4 mm at the polar edge, 4 x 3 mm at the equatorial (width x depth); PROPOSED. The drawing's square tops leave 7 kV/mm in the PEEK at their corners once settled
value.dimensions_check: r 30 / |z| 72 hold: the air outside the coupler at 0.55 kV/mm (switch-on), the coils at 43 C, the glass at 32-37 C (sim/hub-beads-settled-findings.md §6, sim/hub-thermal-findings.md)

retainer.status: DECIDED (role; material: the designer, 2026-10-09) / PROPOSED (the grooves' shape; the dimensions' first cut, docs/rings-design.md §2)
retainer.source: designer, 2026-10-08 (role), 2026-10-09 (accepted PEEK, the gel and the G10 coupler); the material from sim/hub-rings-build-findings.md: non-magnetic and non-conducting (no effect on the AH), low eps (the field at the null moves under 1 % from eps 2.1 to 4.7), low moisture, machines and holds size; the dimensions a placeholder that encloses the AH coils

value.material: silicone gel, two-part, degassed and vacuum-cast into the retainer's pocket
value.role: fills the glass-retainer interface without voids, beds the beads, and takes the PEEK-glass expansion mismatch

interface_filler.source: sim/hub-rings-build-findings.md; accepted by the designer 2026-10-09; eps datasheet-class

value.material: G10, outside the retainer (not against the glass or the rings)
value.shape: PROPOSED first cut: a straight G10 tube, 60 / 66 mm, |z| <= 80 mm, bonded over the PEEK retainer and over both shaft flanges, the flanges turned to 60 mm and each pinned radially (docs/rings-design.md §2); the tube's bicone was a placeholder

shaft_coupler.status: DECIDED (role; G10 outside the PEEK: the designer, 2026-10-09) / PROPOSED (shape, dimensions)
shaft_coupler.source: designer, 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09; G10's fibres would give a tracking path at the rings, so PEEK takes the inside

value.layout: the same shaft top and bottom, one half per side

shaft.status: DECIDED (layout, the flanges outside the vessel, outboard of the AH) / REGISTER (d)
shaft.source: designer, 2026-10-08 / 2026-10-09 ('the AH flanges sit outside the vessel'; the 160-turn coil kept); presets/electromagnets-RA.json shaft (d 30, non-magnetic tip); sim/stack_sizing.py FLANGE_R / FLANGE_T. The tube layout still carries the 120 mm placeholder hub: refreshing it puts the flanges at |z| 72 and grows the tube by about 24 mm.

pumps.value: symmetric top and bottom: each shaft half carries its side's electrostatic stack and magnetic (utron) group (the tube layout's sides A / B)

value: the ratings: the interface along the glass and the gel at the beads (they set the stages: bench test phase 1)
each ring's leakage (100 G estimate: bench test phase 2)

the conductivities at temperature (bench test phase 3): the equatorial beads need sigma_glass <= 4.1 sigma_gel (4.4 with the full-round grooves) at the hub's temperature, about 2.4 in service (sim/hub-thermal-findings.md); and the partial-discharge watch through phase 3's settled state for voids at the contacts (sim/hub-joints-findings.md §4)

the designer's to accept (PROPOSED): the retainer split at the equator, the grooves' full-round tops, the AH ends rounded to 1.5 mm at REF, the coupler as a G10 tube over the retainer and both flanges, the leads' path (docs/rings-design.md §2), and the joints' finish (rings.joints)
the fired-on coating's edges for the later build (beaded, or graded by a resistive layer toward the pole)
